name: Physical Health
overview: Scripture reveals that physical health is a divine provision and responsibility, as God has given humanity every herb and fruit for sustenance (Genesis 1:29). Trusting and obeying the Lord's commandments leads to protection from disease, since He is the healer (Exodus 15:26). Recognizing that we are wonderfully made by God (Psalms 139:14) encourages a holistic care that includes both body and spirit, with joy acting as a healing medicine and a broken spirit harming the bones (Proverbs 17:22). Wisdom calls us to attentively listen and rely on God rather than our own understanding in maintaining health (Proverbs 3:5; 4:20).
